programmes.programName: PhD Program, Graduate School of Business Administration
programmes.evidence: The business school's opened PhD Program page displays a Division/Areas table with Technology and Operations Management in Management Theory in Practice. Kobe University's graduate-school page independently places Operations Management under Management within its PhD Program and describes a Ph.D. thesis. Both are recorded as one broad doctoral programme with named operations areas, not two distinct awards.
limitations: Official pages differ in grouping and wording of operations area; exact current pathway structure needs reconciliation.

branches.conclusion: Current business PhD Program and named Technology and Operations Management area verified; institutional page also lists Operations Management in PhD management fields. Wider named-area structure and whether these labels denote same pathway remain to reconcile.
Engineering doctoral hosts and named fields not yet reviewed.
